name: Close
label: Close REST API v1 — leads, contacts, opportunities, activities
description: Official Close REST API v1 at https://api.close.com/api/v1. Handler: OfficialApiNode. API key as HTTP Basic (key = username). Trailing slashes required. Call recordings and activity bodies are PII — do not log. trigger.listen is BPMN ingress. Customer owns the Close account. api_key is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"lead.get"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: lead.create | lead.get | lead.list | lead.update | lead.delete | contact.create | contact.get | contact.list | contact.update | opportunity.create | opportunity.get | opportunity.list | opportunity.update | call.create | call.get | email.create | sms.create | task.create | task.get | activity.list | customActivity.create | customObject.create | customObject.update | membership.add | membership.remove | trigger.listen. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event, no socket).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id (lead_…, cont_…, oppo_…, task_…, membership). Required for get/update/delete.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Display name: lead/company or contact name, and the required custom object instance name on customObject.create. Example: Acme Corp.

schema.label: lead_id
schema.description: Parent lead id for contact/opportunity/activity/task create.

schema.label: query
schema.description: lead.list search/filter string.

schema.label: _skip
schema.description: List offset. Prefer date windows over deep skip.

schema.label: _limit
schema.description: Page size (respect per-resource max).

schema.label: _fields
schema.description: Comma-separated projection. Prefer this to cut PII.

schema.label: emails
schema.description: Contact emails [{email, type}]. Minimize.

schema.label: phones
schema.description: Contact phones [{phone, type}]. Minimize.

schema.label: status_id
schema.description: Lead or opportunity status id.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Opportunity amount (minor units per Close).

schema.label: direction
schema.description: call.create: inbound | outbound.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Required by email.create and sms.create. EXACT: inbox | draft | scheduled | outbox | sent | error; outbox sends immediately. Example: outbox.

schema.label: text
schema.description: SMS or task text (PII). Do not log.

schema.label: custom_activity_type_id
schema.description: customActivity.create type id.

schema.label: role_id
schema.description: Required by membership.add. EXACT: superuser | user | restricteduser, or a custom role id. Manage Organization permission required. Example: user.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Request-body parameter `url` for operations: lead.create, lead.update.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: lead.create, lead.update.

schema.label: contacts
schema.description: Request-body parameter `contacts` for operation: lead.create.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Request-body parameter `title` for operations: contact.create, contact.update.

schema.label: value_period
schema.description: Request-body parameter `value_period` for operations: opportunity.create, opportunity.update.

schema.label: note
schema.description: Request-body parameter `note` for operations: opportunity.create, opportunity.update, call.create.

schema.label: duration
schema.description: Request-body parameter `duration` for operation: call.create.

schema.label: phone
schema.description: Request-body parameter `phone` for operation: call.create.

schema.label: contact_id
schema.description: Request-body parameter `contact_id` for operation: email.create.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Email subject for email.create (needed when sending; omit only with template_id). Example: Following up on our call.

schema.label: body_html
schema.description:
HTML body for email.create; send body_html and/or body_text, or omit both to render template_id. Example:

Hi Jane,

.

schema.label: body_text
schema.description: Plain-text body for email.create; send body_text and/or body_html (or rely on template_id). Example: Hi Jane, thanks for your time today.

schema.label: sender
schema.description: Sender for email.create in the form "Name" <address>; required by Close for status inbox, scheduled, outbox or error. Example: "John Smith" <john@example.com>.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Recipient email addresses for email.create (needed to send an outbox/scheduled email). Example: ["jane@example.com"].

schema.label: local_phone
schema.description: Sending phone number (E.164) for sms.create; must be an internal Close phone number. Required to send unless caller_id_mode is auto. Example: +14155550100.

schema.label: remote_phone
schema.description: Recipient phone number (E.164) for sms.create; needed to send an SMS. Example: +14155550123.

schema.label: date
schema.description: Request-body parameter `date` for operation: task.create.

schema.label: assigned_to
schema.description: Request-body parameter `assigned_to` for operation: task.create.

schema.label: _type
schema.description: Query-string parameter `_type` for operation: activity.list.

schema.label: custom_fields
schema.description: Request-body parameter `custom_fields` for operations: customActivity.create, customObject.create, customObject.update.

schema.label: custom_object_type_id
schema.description: Custom Object type id for customObject.create (required); determines which custom fields apply. Example: cotype_3OOaHjBnmpsgJ3jYBnsWdw.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Email address of the user to add on membership.add (required, with role_id); must belong to a verified organization domain. Example: new.rep@example.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Log ids only — bodies may contain PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: lead.create, lead.get, lead.list, lead.update, lead.delete, contact.create, contact.get, contact.list, contact.update, opportunity.create, opportunity.get, opportunity.list, opportunity.update, call.create, call.get, email.create, sms.create, task.create, task.get, activity.list, customActivity.create, customObject.create, customObject.update, membership.add, membership.remove, trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Close API key (Settings → Developer → API Keys). HTTP Basic username. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
